description: 车牺牲消除象，两步绝杀
explanation_en: White sacrifices a rook to force the bishop away from d7, removing its defense of e8 and enabling a back-rank checkmate.

intro.popup: 💡 消除保护：黑象Bd7守住了e8格，阻止Re8#。白方如何一步消除这个保护？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Remove the defender: Black's bishop on d7 guards e8 and prevents Re8#. How can White remove this defender in one move?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rc8+！牺牲车强制Bxc8，象离开d7，Re8#！两步绝杀的完美示范。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rc8+ sacrifices the rook and forces Bxc8, drawing the bishop away from d7. Then Re8# is mate.

moves.popup: 车牺牲Rc8+！强制黑象必须应将——Bxc8，否则被将死。
moves.popup_en: White sacrifices the rook with Rc8+, forcing the bishop to respond with Bxc8; otherwise, Black is checkmated.

moves.popup: 象被迫吃车，d7清空——e8门户大开！
moves.popup_en: The bishop is forced to capture the rook, vacating d7 and leaving e8 unprotected.

moves.popup: Re8#！将死！象已不在，e8无人保护。
moves.popup_en: Re8# is checkmate! The bishop has left d7, so e8 is no longer defended.
